SELECT
  MAX(subq_11.order_count) AS order_count
  , MAX(subq_11.valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , MAX(subq_11.net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_11.buyer_count) AS buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_18.new_member_count) AS new_member_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count
    , SUM(CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_order_count
    , SUM(case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end) AS net_sales_cents
    , COUNT(DISTINCT case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then member_id end) AS buyer_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_11
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_member_count
  FROM "data"."main"."members" members_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', registered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_18
